question.text: Stock exchanges, depositories and clearing corporations are collectively referred to as:

explanation.text: The Logic: Workbook p.34 defines Market Infrastructure Institutions (MIIs) as stock exchanges, depositories and clearing corporations. That definition supports the keyed answer directly. The Trap: Custodians (B) hold assets on behalf of institutional investors, KYC Registration Agencies (C) maintain KYC records, and Asset Management Companies (D) manage mutual funds. Each is described separately on pp.34-35 as a different intermediary role. Note: The MII definition on p.34 and the distinct custodian, KRA, and AMC roles on pp.34-35 together explain why MII is the correct collective term.
